newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen opening lower on GDP data.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen opening lower on GDP data.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open lower Wednesday because of a sharp jump in U.S. real Gross Domestic Product (GDP) for the first quarter.
Analysts said the 5.6 percent annual rise -- the greatest increase for the quarter in nine years -- could help prompt the U.S. central bank to raise interest rates next month.
The U.S. Treasury 30-year bond was off 17/32 to yield 7.03 percent after release of the figures. The Standard & Poors 500 futures index eased to be off 3.55 to 796.25.
